requirements.verbatim: Deposit New Money directly into new account within thirty (30) days of account opening
Maintain a daily balance meeting the Balance Requirement during Maintenance Period (days 31-90)

fee_waiver: None for first 12 months; after that, waived with $5,000 combined average balance OR $500+ in net debit card purchases OR Preferred Rewards for Business membership

churn.limit_language_verbatim: not eligible if you were an owner or signer on a BofA Business Advantage Banking account within the last twelve (12) months

superseded_values.evidence: Update 7/7/26: There is a new bonus for up to $2,500

notes: Maintenance Period begins day 31 and ends day 90 after account opening (i.e., balance must be held for 60 days following the 30-day deposit window, with account open a total of 90 days). Credit card funding allowed up to $300 via debit card only (no CC funding). Deposit period = 30 days is treated as deadline_days; hold_days=90 represents total days from opening through end of Maintenance Period per bonus chart language.
